data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 injects an unbounded tax-scope variable that the problem never introduces, then treats the pen price as underdetermined. In the problem as stated, the two constraints n + p = 12.50 and n = p + 10 form a closed system with a unique solution p = 1.25; there is no missing tax parameter. The offered counterconditions only help if an external tax regime is stipulated, which the problem does not do. The causal demand is unsatisfied because the artifact never supplies a mechanism that maps a problem-internal feature to non-identifiability — it merely speculates that unmentioned tax considerations could alter the totals, which is true of any price problem and does not show THIS problem is underdetermined.
